notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for joined-federate MOM reflection counts. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM declarations, HLAsetTiming, HLAinteger32BE, HLAbyte, the adapter-supplied logical-time implementation, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and application object/attribute names. It verifies direct and periodic HLAobjectInstancesReflected/HLAreflectionsReceived accounting, ordinary and timestamped reflection callbacks, time-advance ordering, nested MOM data-element decoding, and cleanup without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador joined-federate MOM reflection-count, time-management, and periodic-reporting services with FederateAmbassador reflection and logical-time callbacks
